Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.The tenderer with past performance of satisfactory execution of contracts to WCR Railwa y, or Other Zonal Railways/PUs/Government department for supply of the Convection Heate rs - Room Heater, Blower for a quantity of 20 percent or more of tendered quantity against a single contract during during the period of three previous completed financial year and c urrent financial year up to date of tender closing may be considered as responsive to WCR Railways requirements for placement of bulk and regular order. (b) Successfull supply shall mean acceptance of supply by consignee i.e. Consignee Receipt & Acceptance Certificate(CRAC) or Consignee Receipt Note (CRN) or R-Note or Supply Perfo rmance issued by Gazetted Officer of consignee (Completion report) along with offer. Firm must upload documentary evidence regarding the past successful supply performance faili ng which offer will be summarily rejected without making any back reference. Submissions of mere purchase orders or invoice will not be considered as proof of successf ull supply and such documents will not be cosidered for qualification under eligibility condit ions. 2. TENDER SPECIFIC AUTHORIZATION: - Authorized agents of OEM must submit Bid Specific Authorization of the OEM. No back reference will be made in this regard & communication r eceived after opening of tender will also not be entertained. Failure to submit bid specific O EM authorization will lead to summarily rejection of the offer. 3. In case, the tenderer participates as an authorized dealer, then the performance as requi red above shall be that of Principal (OEM) authorizing the agent or bidder for the same OEM . It may so happen that the agent/dealer has credentials of past supply for a different Princi pal/OEM, then it will not be considered as performance. For Authorised dealers, bid specific authorization from OEM has to be uploaded with bid. 4. No fresh document will be accepted after tender opening date. 5. Supplier shall be responsible for safe packing, transportation, unloading and delivery at t he designated site. 6.Following document submitted by supplier at time of supply of material 1. Manufacture's i nternal/routine test inspection certificate & testing report. 2. Purchase proof from OEM and OEM warranty certificate. 7. The Room Heater offered by the tenderer shall comply with the applicable BIS standards and shall bear the ISI Mark under BIS Scheme-I (ISI Mark Certification Scheme), wherever a pplicable.

The tenderer shall submit a valid BIS licence issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) in the name of the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) whose product is being offered against this tender. The purchaser reserves the right to verify the authenticity and validity of the submitted BIS licence directly from the BIS portal or the issuing authority. Offers not accompanied by a valid and applicable BIS licence of the OEM shall be treated as non-responsive and shall not be considered for further evaluation. .
